display.purpose: TSB/CTL/ATL hero numbers on dashboard. Once per page.

headline.purpose: Card titles, section labels, page headings.

label.purpose: Metric units, uppercase short labels. ≤4 words.

mono.purpose: All pace, HR, duration, percentage values. tabular-nums always.

shadows.name: inset-edge
shadows.purpose: Top-edge LED rim on all surface-card elements. Non-negotiable.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Mobile → desktop layout switch. Primary breakpoint.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action — nav to coach, save, confirm. Strava orange fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #fc4c02; color: #efeff3; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; border: none; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, transform 0.1s ease; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #e04400; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); background: #cc3d00; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fc4c02; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary actions — export, cancel, navigate. Surface-tinted, minimal.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: #17171b; color: #888896; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #1e1e23; color: #efeff3; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: Icon-only controls — nav arrows, calendar, download. 40px mobile / 28px desktop.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-icon" aria-label="Previous week"><svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><polyline points="15 18 9 12 15 6"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-icon { width: 40px; height: 40px; background: #17171b; color: #888896; border: none; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } @media (min-width: 768px) { .ds-btn-icon { width: 28px; height: 28px; } } .ds-btn-icon:hover { background: #1e1e23; color: #efeff3; } .ds-btn-icon:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Surface Card
components.description: Primary container for dashboard widgets, coach panels, activity details.
components.css: .ds-surface-card { background: #101013; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.07) inset, 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); padding: 20px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-card-label { font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #888896; margin: 0 0 4px; } .ds-card-metric { font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 800; color: #efeff3; letter-spacing: -0.04em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; margin: 0; font-family: ui-monospace, SF Mono, monospace; }

components.name: Workout Chip — Easy Run
components.description: Color-coded workout type badge. Tinted background, 100% zone color text. Used on plan grid and activity detail.
components.html: EASY RUN
components.css: .ds-chip-easy { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: rgba(48,209,88,0.08); color: #30d158; border: 1px solid rgba(48,209,88,0.3); border-radius: 10px; padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; }

components.name: Workout Chip — Intervals
components.description: High-intensity workout badge. Red zone variant.
components.html: INTERVALS
components.css: .ds-chip-interval { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: rgba(255,69,58,0.08); color: #ff453a; border: 1px solid rgba(255,69,58,0.3); border-radius: 10px; padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form field for Strava activity IDs and text inputs in coach composer.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #17171b; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07); border-radius: 8px; color: #efeff3; font-size: 0.875rem; font-family: ui-monospace, SF Mono, monospace; padding: 6px 12px; width: 100%; transition: border-color 0.15s ease; outline: none; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.25); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: rgba(252,76,2,0.5); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Bottom Navigation
components.description: Mobile fixed bottom nav. Active item shows Strava orange animated underline. Touch target 44px min.
components.css: .ds-bottom-nav { display: flex; align-items: stretch; justify-content: space-around; background: #101013; border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07); width: 100%; } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 3px; flex: 1; background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 10px 8px 8px; color: #888896; position: relative; transition: color 0.2s; min-height: 44px; } .ds-nav-item::after { content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: 6px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); width: 32px; height: 2px; border-radius: 999px; background: #fc4c02; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.25s ease; } .ds-nav-item.active { color: #fc4c02; } .ds-nav-item.active::after { opacity: 1; } .ds-nav-icon { width: 20px; height: 20px; } .ds-nav-label { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; text-transform: capitalize; color: inherit; white-space: nowrap; letter-spacing: 0.02em; line-height: 1; }

narrative.overview:
Runiqlo is a physiologist's analysis tool, not a fitness app. The interface inherits from sports science workstations and terminal data readers: near-black surfaces with precise numerical readouts, where color serves as signal — zone indicators, effort calibration, trend status — never as decoration. The UI disappears; the data speaks.

The system rejects fitness-app clichés completely: no streak badges, no motivational gradients, no orange-and-blue activity feeds. It rejects generic SaaS equally: no sidebar-nav card grids, no hero metrics with purple gradients. This is a precision instrument. Every element visible on screen must directly inform a training decision.

Dark is not a theme choice — it is the product's identity. The athlete uses this at 6am before a run and at 9pm reviewing a session.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black base with four ascending surface tones, no mid-grays
Color is semantic only: effort zones, sport types, training status — never decoration
Strava orange as the sole accent; used for active states and primary actions only
Single typeface (Geist) — hierarchy through weight and scale, not family switching
Tabular-nums throughout all metric displays — alignment is precision
No decorative shadows; depth from surface steps only

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Zone colors are the color vocabulary. Each maps to a specific training intensity. Never reassign a zone color to a non-training use case.

rules.name: The Rarity Rule
rules.body: Strava orange appears once per screen at most. When everything is orange, nothing is urgent.

rules.name: The Mono Data Rule
rules.body: Every numeric metric uses font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums and Geist Mono when column alignment is needed.

rules.name: The No-Scale-Clamp Rule
rules.body: Body text and labels use fixed rem, never fluid clamp. Product UI viewed at consistent DPI.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Four surface tones create hierarchy through color, not shadow.

rules.name: The No-Glassmorphism-Default Rule
rules.body: Backdrop blur is legacy. New components use solid surface colors.

dos: Use tabular-nums and Geist Mono for every pace, HR, duration, and percentage value
Use zone colors as the sole semantic color vocabulary
Use --radius-card (14px) on all cards and --radius-inner (10px) on chips, inputs, and buttons
Step surface colors up one level for hover states, never add a shadow on hover
Include the box-shadow inset edge highlight on every surface-card
Use Strava orange exclusively for active nav, primary CTA, and today's workout highlight
donts: Don't add border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored stripe on cards or list items
Don't use glassmorphism (backdrop-blur) on new components
Don't build a generic SaaS dashboard: no purple gradients, no card-grid hero metrics
Don't use fitness-influencer aesthetics: no streaks, no bright motivational colors
Don't replicate Garmin Connect's feature-bloat layouts
Don't replicate Strava's blue/orange activity feed card grid
Don't use transition: width or any CSS layout-property animation
Don't mix font families for hierarchy — one family, weight contrast only
